units.source_text: 我们呆呆的站在那里，目送着托喀的走远。

en.t: We stood there blankly, watching Tokk walk away.

units.source_text: 我们——不，学生拉卟早就不在我身侧了，

en.t: We - no, the student Rapp was already no longer at my side,

units.source_text: 不知何时，他已跑到马路中央，叉开腿，弯身从胯下观看络绎不绝的汽车和河童。

en.t: Before I knew it, he had run into the middle of the road, spread his legs, bent over, and was watching the endless stream of cars and kappa from between his legs.
